name: robots/ipa320__cob_simulation
title: Care-O-bot Gazebo simulation scene
intro: Care-O-bot Gazebo simulation scene, adapted from ipa320/cob_simulation. It reads `model_names` and `robot_pose`; runs `delete_model` and `publish_model_state`. `delete_model`: call the acknowledged gazebo_msgs/DeleteModel service to remove one model from the running Gazebo world; the output is the service's own success and status text. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
